subject: Veridian onboarding — day-of coverage plan, backup slots, and cancellation policy
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@veridian.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Veridian onboarding — proposed dates for Console + API walkthrough

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood Inference. Wanted to get calendar availability on the console walkthrough + API enablement lab. We usually run these as a 2.5 hour session (90m console + 60m API deep-dive) but can compress to 2 hours if you prefer. Proposed slots (PDT):

- Tue Apr 6, 09:00–11:30
- Wed Apr 7, 13:00–15:30
- Thu Apr 8, 08:00–10:30

Please let us know which of those works best for your team, how many engineers will join, and whether you want the API deep-dive to include model quantization/latency tuning.

Attached: training_agenda.pdf (high-level agenda + pre-reqs).

Operational notes: I’ll lead the console portion; I’ve cc’d Sean to coordinate day-of coverage and backups in case of last-minute conflicts. We’ll also provide a shared Git repo with sample prompts and a sandbox API key (short-lived).

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: training_agenda.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

From: Olivia Chen <olivia@veridian.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <customersuccess@veridian.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Veridian onboarding — proposed dates for Console + API walkthrough

Hi Monica —

Thanks for the options. Heads-up on constraints for our engineering org:
- Tue Apr 6: split day for us (hard conflict)
- Wed Apr 7: good but we have a 15:00 GMT call with a partner (should be fine)
- Thu Apr 8: early slot may be tough for our EU folks

Can we do Wed Apr 7, 13:00–15:30 PDT? That would give most of our engineers time to join.

Attendees likely: myself, Samir (CS lead), and two engineers (Priya K., Tomas L.). We’d like the API section to cover: auth/key rotation, request shaping for throughput, and an example of using the prefix cache. Also important: can you include a brief segment on MFA/KMS access for the sandbox?

If you can confirm, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short list of pre-reqs.

Thanks,
Olivia
Head of Platform
Veridian AI

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@veridian.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Veridian onboarding — day-of coverage plan and backups

Olivia / Monica —

Wed Apr 7, 13:00–15:30 PDT works for Redwood. Confirming a few operational items and the day-of roster so we’re covered if anyone needs to swap:

Day-of roles (Redwood):
- Lead presenter: Sean Gallagher (console walkthrough & rollout strategy)
- Secondary lead / API deep-dive: Monica Patel (90m -> will split with Sean where needed)
- Env & access lead: Dev Patel (handles sandbox keys, KMS provisioning, short-lived credentials)
- Manager on standby: Lauren Bishop (escalation contact, will join first 15m)

Backups: If Sean is pulled, Monica will run the console and I will jump into the API deep-dive. If Monica is pulled, Lauren will run the first 30m of console and Dev will cover the access walkthrough.

Cancellation / reschedule policy: We require 48 hours notice for a reschedule without penalty. Last-minute cancellations (<48h) may result in a reduced hands-on package; we’ll still provide the recorded session and a follow-up office hours slot.

Pre-reqs for Veridian engineers:
- Confirm attendee list + target features (console only vs console + API tuning)
- Provide a list of accounts that need sandbox access (email addresses)
- Confirm whether KMS integration will be tested in sandbox

Attached: day_of_roster.csv (names + roles) and access_instructions.md (sandbox access checklist).

I’ll send the final calendar invite once Olivia confirms attendee list. Looking forward to it.

—Sean
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: day_of_roster.csv (CSV, 1 KB)
Attachment: access_instructions.md (Markdown, 2 pages)
